Neither solution is correct. The correct answer is **10 meters**.

The robot's speed is 1000 m / (2.5 × 3600 s) = 1000 / 9000 = 1/9 m/s. Over 90 seconds it covers (1/9) × 90 = 10 m.

**Solution A** sets up the problem correctly, but it makes an arithmetic error. It writes 1000 / (2.5 × 3600) as 4000/9000 instead of 1000/9000. That doubles the speed to 4/9 m/s and gives 40 m.

**Solution B** misreads the first fact. It uses 2500 meters instead of 1000 meters for 1 km, which gives v = 2500/9000 = 5/18 m/s and x = 25 m.

Both final answers are wrong. A has the correct setup and a single arithmetic slip, while B has a conceptual misreading of the given distance, so A is marginally more likely to be fixable to the right answer.

WINNER: A
